current.text: Jackson is eligible for a contract extension but has not been extended.
Joe thinks Jackson will see some opportunity, possibly at small forward.
The Memphis forward group is crowded, with Prosper, Hendricks, Edey, Stewart and Cameron Boozer. Boozer will start.
Joe's projected starting five does not include Jackson: Ty Jerome, Cedric Coward, Jerami Grant, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo runs an 11-man rotation with short stints and keeps minutes down. Joe expects only Boozer and Coward to top 30 minutes, which caps Jackson's minutes.
Jackson is not a draft target in a 144-player league. He is worth watching on waivers if he wins small forward minutes.

durable.text: No category stands out. His projected line is slightly below the top 250 pool in most categories, and his rebounds and assists are low for a forward or center.
